I am an old man now, 67 years, and I have farmed this small piece of land in Nsanje all my life. Sorghum is what grows best here because the rains are not reliable and the heat is strong, and I keep my own seed from last year's harvest like my father did. Fertilizer from the shop is too costly for me, so I put the kraal manure from my goats on the field before the rains. My sons and their wives help me weed, and when the birds come for the grain my grandchildren chase them away.
